text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Temporarily closed today due to urgent owner business"...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Is there another cafe nearby—
...A 30-minute walk?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Tch...
And here I came all this way just to blow off some steam...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli ended up expending her energy
on unexpected matters.
